title: Story premise EDU022: The Four-Bit Lantern
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Four lamps, thirteen signals: how? Takeaway/theme: Binary place value uses powers of two.
description: A technician must display thirteen using four binary lamps, but initially reads 1101 as ordinary decimal digits. Labeling lamp weights eight, four, two, and one makes the lit total clear.
